terminology.train_gain: Exact realized nonoverlapping training compression for the selected pair, conditional on native statistics/replacement semantics.
terminology.descent: Floating-point objective decrease greater than 1e-12; fairness is a constraint only when such a feasible pair exists.
terminology.exact_train: No-descent-constraint, minmax-tiebroken exact-train-gain control; it is not development-blind and its fallback count is not comparable to candidate fallback counts.

rational_gap_bound.interpretation: For observed nonincreasing positive integer costs, a mathematically nonzero rational Gini difference is bounded above the tolerance. The executed selector still used float64, so reports retain its actual thresholded-float semantics rather than claiming symbolic arithmetic.

verification_response: The completed trainer used ordinary python3, but its assert-backed hard-coded success flags are not accepted alone. A separate replay task will use explicit RuntimeError checks over every selected merge and independent final tokenizer totals.
eligibility: Compatibility rule remains native raw adjacency frequency >=2 and novel concatenated symbol; corrected nonoverlap gain controls selection, not eligibility.
claim_scope: All Books/TICO outcomes remain exposed development diagnostics. Favorable results cannot establish confirmation, novelty, causal mechanism, third-language robustness or broad fairness.
